# Session — 2026-05-18 22:30

## What we were working on

P&L dashboard was bugged — paper book balance flicked from the correct value
to ~$20 on the first scan tick. Diagnosed it as **three bugs stacked** in the
trading engine: closed positions were double-counted on load, the live wallet
balance was clobbering the paper book every scan, and `_starting_balance()`
silently shifted its anchor when a live CLOB client was wired in. Then audited
the 118-line paper trade log, identified the only profitable cohort
(entry ≤ 0.20) and the dominant loss source (NO entries between 0.40 and 0.60),
shipped a Kelly cap boost for the profitable cohort, and held off on cutting
the losing one per Tali's preference to wait for more data. Finally restructured
the engine so paper-sports trading actually works alongside live weather
trading — a `LIVE_TRADING=true` + `SPORTS_ALERT_ONLY=true` config was previously
silently no-opping every sports opportunity.

## Audit findings (paper book, n=58 closes)

- **Total P&L: −$19.17 (−1.92%)** at win rate 32%, payoff ratio 1.71×, break-even WR 37% — slightly underwater on expectancy.
- **Only profitable bucket: entry ≤ 0.20** — 10 trades, +$27.47. Cheap-tail cohort where the model's "this longshot is mispriced" call has actual edge.
- **Loss source: NO 0.40–0.60** — 0W / 8L, −$25.47 (130% of total paper loss). NO 0.60–0.80 is 32% WR — basically baseline noise.
- **Side bias:** 49 NO vs 9 YES closes. NO side realized −$38.55, YES +$19.38. The bot is structurally short weather tails and the markets keep proving it wrong.
- **Hold-time asymmetry is healthy:** winners 35.4h, losers 15.5h — exit logic lets winners run.

## Open problems

Problems are ordered **critical → high → medium → minor**.

### Critical

- [ ] `CRIT-001` — `uv run scan` hangs at startup. Reported but not diagnosed — session was interrupted before root cause was found. Most likely candidates in order: (a) stale `data/trades/bot.pid` lock from a previous run; (b) `set_clob_client()` blocking on a synchronous `clob.get_balance()` RPC call against the Polymarket gateway; (c) instance lock prompting input. **How to verify solved:** `uv run scan` reaches "Polymarket Bot starting up..." log line and "Scan #1 started" within 30 seconds. First quick check: `cat data/trades/bot.pid` then `ps -p $(cat data/trades/bot.pid)` — if stale, `rm data/trades/bot.pid`.

### High

- [ ] `HIGH-001` — Engine has been silently no-opping sports opportunities for any run with `LIVE_TRADING=true` + `SPORTS_ALERT_ONLY=true`. Fixed in this session, but if any phantom sports rows were appended before the fix they would have `live_platform="polymarket_us"`, `live_order_id=None`, `clob_order_id=None`. **How to verify solved:** `jq 'select(.live_platform=="polymarket_us" and .live_order_id==null and .clob_order_id==null and .status=="open")' data/trades/trades.jsonl` returns nothing. - [ ] `HIGH-002` — `TRADE_LOG_PATH` is a module-level constant resolved relative to the project root. Tests must monkeypatch it or they read/write the real production log. Three test files now do this via an autouse fixture; new test files don't get the guarantee automatically. **How to verify solved:** `TRADE_LOG_PATH` is sourced from `settings.trade_log_path` so the env layer enforces isolation, and the monkeypatch fixtures can be deleted.
